name: 95838 · Sacramento, CA
findings: ZIP 95838 (Sacramento) has 122 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 27 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (54% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95838 (Sacramento) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 95838 (Sacramento) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
